game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mystic Forest – Waterfall Pool, a pool below a waterfall: the herbalist must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Reverse Countdown: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches.
theme: Mystic Forest – Waterfall Pool: a pool below a waterfall
core_gameplay_loop: In Waterfall Pool, repeat each round: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches. Each round, shadow wolves strike the seed vault, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the launch_timing value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the seed vault from shadow wolves in Waterfall Pool: keep the launch_timing meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: launch_timing drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Reverse Countdown
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how launch_timing changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wolves in Waterfall Pool.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while launch_timing > 0.
